label: negative
description: onlyOwner is removed from setFee(), but an equivalent inline require(msg.sender == owner()) is added in the same function in the same commit.
why_labeled: The protection was relocated, not removed. The inline require enforces exactly the constraint the modifier did (msg.sender must equal owner()). A name-only detector sees the modifier disappear and fires; a body-aware detector recognizes the inline check as an equivalent msg.sender constraint and stays quiet. Exclusion 1.2.
